newsitem.title: USA: Mobil Green Canyon back to full capacity.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Green Canyon back to full capacity.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Thursday that its Green Canyon 18 and 60 oil platforms offshore Louisiana have returned to full service, months ahead of schedule, following a December 10 fire.
Mobil spokesman Chris Springham said platform 18 has reached full capacity production of 23,000 barrels per day (bpd) of oil and 32 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of gas.
"Limited production began on number 18 late on February 4, and it is now up to full facility capacity," Springham said.
Platform 60 reached full capacity February 8, producing 1,600 bpd of oil and 8 mmcfd of gas.
Springham noted that original projections had pegged the platforms to be out of service for up to four months, but in fact the return to regular operations was completed in less than two months.
